row.evidence: OrbStack's licensing docs say: "Support for provisioning users with SCIM is planned, but not yet supported."
row.notes: Unchanged from June (none). Pro $8/user/mo billed annually ($96/yr). SAML SSO is Enterprise only (Contact sales) and needs at least 15 seats; Google/GitHub sign-in is on all plans but is not customer-IdP SSO. Organizations can auto-join or auto-invite users by verified email domain and auto-assign pooled licenses on sign-in; no SCIM and no admin API.
